synthesis:draft.headline: TOTALDEMAND in DISPATCHREGIONSUM is "Demand (less loads)."
summary: TOTALDEMAND is a DISPATCHREGIONSUM field described as "Demand (less loads)." [c1]

AEMO defines TotalDemand in dispatch with a formula beginning: "TotalDemand = Sum of InitialMW Over all Regional Scheduled and Semi-scheduled generating units – Sum of InitialMW Over all Regional Scheduled Loads" and including adjustments for scheduled BDUs, wholesale demand response, interconnector flows and losses, DemandForecast and AggregateDispatchError (ADE). [c2]

The Regional Energy Balance equation using EMMS terms places TotalDemand on the right-hand side: "DispatchableGeneration + Net Interconnector Targets (into the Region) = TotalDemand + DispatchableLoad – WDR_Dispatched + Allocated Interconnector Losses". [c3]
